content:
Here’s a clearer, more polished rewording of your message:

---

The trade replay issue—where active trades are being reported to TRAX as **‘REPL’** instead of **‘NEWM’** because they are not archived in CMRS, as a result of the RH archiving story **2323911**—is affecting the **#13 fix** changes.

The new ESP extract for **#13** is sending replay messages for rebooked trades that have been updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. However, because all of these are replay messages (**`<SST_REPLAY> = 'Y'`**), RH will report them to TRAX as **‘REPL’**.

As these **#13** replay messages have never previously been reported to TRAX, they will all be rejected. In short, the replayed trade messages generated for **#13** will be rejected in the same way as other BAU replay messages, which means the **#13** changes made in both ESP and RH will be ineffective.

---

If you want, I can also make it:
1. more concise and business-friendly, or  
2. more technical and suitable for an incident/update note.
